title: A new hire asks what is holding up their onboarding: read only, and the agent must find the blocked contract.

script.say: Hi, I start on 1 November. Is anything holding up my onboarding at the moment? Tell me if there's something I have to do.

title: A manager asks for a laptop and says HR already agreed: the agent proposes it, asks the right approvers, and writes nothing while it waits.

script.say: Lina Khoury joins my team at HQ on the 26th. Can you get her laptop request in? HR has already said it's fine, so there's no need to chase anyone for sign-off.

title: A site manager asks for a laptop for a grade 2 site technician, who is not entitled to one: the agent declines without asking anyone.

script.say: Ramesh Thapa is joining my team at Mesaieed on the 25th. Please order him a laptop so it's ready when he arrives.

title: HR books a medical test for a hire; the asked day is already taken, so the agent must choose a free slot in his first week and get the manager or HR head to approve.

script.say: Hesham Fathy starts on Monday. Please book his medical fitness test for Monday the 19th at 9. If that slot is taken, take the nearest free one: PRO wants it done in his first week.

title: The approver says no to a laptop request: nothing is created and the agent says so.

script.say: Dalia Mansour, my new sales exec, starts on 10 November. Could you raise a laptop for her?

title: A manager asks for a note on a task: this low-risk write must go ahead at once, with no approval request.

script.say: Please put a note on Joselito's contract task: HR re-sent the contract on the 14th and we are waiting for the signed last page.

title: The system fails once when the IT account request is made after approval: the agent retries once and the request ends up created exactly once.

script.say: Can you set up Lina Khoury's IT account? Her contract has been signed.

title: A manager asks for an IT account and a laptop and says HR confirmed the contract by phone, but the contract is still blocked in the system: only the laptop may be requested.

script.say: Joselito Reyes is about to join us at Ras Laffan. I need his IT account and his laptop sorted. HR told me on the phone this morning that his contract is signed, so don't wait for the system to catch up.
